proposals.hypothesis: During pod-kill, the in-memory cart state will be lost (causing checkout failures) and the system will recover by restarting the pod without data restoration.
proposals.reason: redis-cart is stateful and critical for cart/checkout journeys. Prior service-down runs show cart loss, but pod-kill (crash) effects are untested.

proposals.hypothesis: Network delay will cause checkout journey timeouts (increased error rate) but the system will recover quickly without data loss.
proposals.reason: checkoutservice is critical for checkout journey (highest business impact). Prior runs show service-down and pod-kill effects, but network-delay impact is untested.

proposals.hypothesis: Pod-kill will cause currency conversion failures (increased error rate) but the system will recover quickly without data loss.
proposals.reason: currencyservice is critical for all journeys. Prior service-down runs show low error rates, but pod-kill effects are untested.

proposals.hypothesis: Network delay will cause product catalog slowdowns (increased latency) but the system will recover without data loss.
proposals.reason: productcatalogservice is critical for all journeys. Prior service-down runs show high error rates, but network-delay effects are untested.
